description: The plot illustrates how accuracy varies across different x-axis values for three series, each shown with error bars. The x-axis is labeled with numeric values from 0.91 to 0.98 on a linear scale, with ticks at every 0.01 increment. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” shown on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.2 intervals. One series is a blue solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.85 at x=0.91, reaching 1.00 at x=0.92, then staying close to 0.97–1.00 through x=0.98 (e.g., about 0.98 at x=0.94 and 1.00 at x=0.96 and x=0.98). A second series is an orange dashed line with diamond markers, rising from about 0.65 at x=0.91 to about 0.92 at x=0.92, then decreasing across the remaining x-values to about 0.08 at x=0.98 (with intermediate points around 0.80 at x=0.93, 0.74 at x=0.94, 0.56 at x=0.95, and 0.21 at x=0.97). The third series is a green dash-dot line with square markers, starting around 0.21 at x=0.91, dipping to about 0.07 at x=0.92, then increasing steadily to about 0.91 at x=0.98 (with intermediate values around 0.16 at x=0.93, 0.23 at x=0.94, 0.42 at x=0.95, 0.65 at x=0.96, and 0.78 at x=0.97). Each point in all three series includes vertical error bars of varying size.
